children: Australian shares fell for a second straight session on Friday and were on track for a fourth weekly loss in a row, as rising oil prices reignited inflation concerns and added to worries about the outlook for interest rates.

In Australia, persistent inflation pressures, fuelled by soaring energy bills and heavy investment in data centres, have led markets to price in another rate hike, which would lift the cash rate to a near 15-year high of 4.60%.

Meanwhile, data on Thursday showed the local jobless rate unexpectedly rose to a five-year high last month, even as employment made a solid rebound, a mixed report that left markets still wagering on an imminent rate hike to fight inflation.
